news.title: Rugby-Spain includes Bernabeu, Camp Nou among venues in 2035 World Cup bid
news.lede: Oct 15 (Reuters) – Spain has put forward some of the country’s biggest football stadiums, including Real Madrid’s Santiago Bernabeu and Barcelona’s Camp Nou, as part of its bid ​to host the 2035 Rugby World Cup, the ‌Spanish Rugby Federation said on Wednesday. The RFER submitted its detailed applicant questionnaire to World Rugby this month and has now unveiled a list of potential venues that also includes Atletico Madrid’s Metropolitano Stadium, as Spain seeks to host ‌the ​event for the first time. Backed by LaLiga, ⁠the bid plans to ⁠capitalise on infrastructure developed for the 2030 football World Cup, which Spain will co-host with Portugal and Morocco. In a statement, the RFER said the proposal would draw on the “venues, transport ​infrastructure, security and volunteer management” associated with staging the football showpiece.

news.title: At Showdown FIFA Meeting, Infantino Apologizes For World Cup Furor But Leaves Critics Unhappy
news.lede: Zurich: Gianni Infantino gave an apology to his toughest critics but no new details or documents on FIFA issues that most concern them at a showdown meeting of its ruling council Thursday. No documents about the $4.2 billion World Cup sell-off plan he launched and dropped in July. No details about the Folarin Balogun red-card case at the World Cup and how U.S. President Donald Trump intervened to help the national team forward.

news.title: Fifa: Gianni Infantino apologises over World Cup move but told he must do more
news.lede: Gianni Infantino celebrated 10 years as Fifa president in February 2026. President Gianni Infantino has apologised to the Fifa Council for his World Cup sell-off plan - but has been told he is not fit to lead unless he releases all of the documents and answers key questions. The Fifa Council met in Zurich on Thursday for the first time since Infantino's secret Fifa Forward Enterprise (FFE) proposal emerged. Under FFE, which Infantino scrapped within days, a portion of the commercial rights of football's world governing body would have been given to a private investment firm.

news.title: Replica of FIFA World Cup trophy lifted by Lionel Messi up for sale
news.lede: Dubai: A replica of the FIFA World Cup trophy lifted by Lionel Messi during Argentina’s celebrations in Qatar in 2022 will go under the hammer at a sports memorabilia auction in November.Richmond Auctions will feature the item at its inaugural Sports Memorabilia Auction on November 7, 2026. The trophy, which was later exhibited at the National Historical Museum of Buenos Aires, became part of some of the most widely shared images from Argentina’s historic triumph.Argentina defeated France 4-2 on penalties after a thrilling 3-3 draw in the World Cup final at Lusail Stadium on December 18, 2022. Messi scored twice, while Kylian Mbappe netted a hat-trick for France before Gonzalo Montiel converted the decisive penalty.During the celebrations, the replica trophy was carried from the stands onto the pitch and passed between Argentina’s players for around 45 minutes.
